args.message: Hi Sara - re Brightwell Packaging PAY-2026-04232 (invoice BP-72860, 6,630.00 USD): the payment is not lost. You created the manual wire on 2026-03-30 at 16:40, after that day's 18:12 bank file had been cut, so it went out in today's file BF-20260331-02. That file was transmitted at 07:41 today and the bank accepted it at 07:55 (ACCP) with value date 2026-03-31. Our imported bank statement only runs through 2026-03-30, which is why you can't see it yet. Brightwell should receive the funds today or on the next business day, depending on their bank. I have NOT released a second payment because that would pay them twice. The invoice is already marked PAID and is not in today's payment run. Please tell Brightwell the value date is 2026-03-31. If it still isn't on tomorrow's statement, or they haven't received it within 1-2 business days, let me know and I'll ask the bank for a trace/recall before we look at any re-payment.
